exchanges: ugh monday again, already need a nap
Hang in there, a nap later sounds well earned.
long shift at fernhollow today, the spring rush is real
Sounds busy, hope the customers were at least nice.
weather was gorgeous tho so i ate lunch outside
Lunch in the sun is the best kind of break.
my bf teodor made soup for dinner so the day is saved
That's sweet of him, a warm dinner fixes a lot.
my sister maren got a puppy and named it pimento lol
Ha, that's a great name for a puppy!
shes sending me videos of it nonstop
Puppy videos are a pretty good thing to be flooded with.
signed up for the evening arboriculture course, kinda nervous
Good for you, it'll be great to learn more about trees.
maren says the pup is a whippet so it just zooms in circles
That breed does love to run, she'll need plenty of space.
tired but cant sleep, classic
Maybe some tea and a dim screen will help you wind down.
went to see maren's flat in larkhill, tiny but she loves it
A cozy place you love beats a big one you don't.
my coworker osric covered for me when i was late, owe him one
That's a good coworker to have around.
might bring him donuts tomorrow
Donuts are a classic thank-you, he'll appreciate it.
my sister in law talia lives out in wickham so we barely see her
Distance makes it hard, but it's nice when you do get together.
she might come down for maren's birthday tho
That would be a nice chance to catch up.
my dad finally sold the van and bought a bronco, midlife crisis much
Ha, at least he's having fun with it.
he keeps offering me rides just to show it off
Sounds like he's very proud of the new ride.
wrist is acting up again, doc says its tendinitis from all the pruning
Ouch, try to rest it when you can and go easy at work.
so now i have a brace, very glamorous
Glamorous or not, it'll help it heal.
bexley is finally reading middlemarch after i nagged her for ages
Nagging pays off, hope she enjoys it.
the ferry was so rough this morning i nearly lost my coffee
Choppy water and hot coffee are a risky combo.
anyway weekend plans are nothing, just sleeping
A slow weekend sounds like exactly what you need.
maybe a movie if im feeling brave
A movie night at home sounds perfect.
my bf has had khruangbin on repeat all week, i know every song now
At least it's music you can both enjoy.
ok going to make tea, chat later
Enjoy your tea, talk soon.
